# GTA6Info.in — GTA 6 news, India release time and countdown

> Fan-run GTA 6 news desk for India. GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) releases on Thursday, 19 November 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S and unlocks at midnight local time — 12:00 AM IST in India. PlayStation Store India lists it at ₹5,999 (Standard) and ₹7,499 (Ultimate). New Zealand unlocks first, 7.5 hours before India. News is updated every few hours with sources linked.
